description: A roster road code, as the rosters and locos.csv give it (BO, CR, CSX). The key; locos.csv's road_name refers to it.
The reporting marks a card shows for the road (B&O). Empty: a card shows the code (engine_lookup.ROAD_DISPLAY).

The spellings read off a car photo that mean this road, ; between them (process_car_images.ROAD_ALIASES). A spelling may be the code itself: the car matcher accepts a road only as one of its spellings. A spelling names one road.
The spellings in a loco row that mean this road, ; between them (engine_lookup.ENGINE_ROAD_ALIASES).
